units: m, grey-box world frame (X east, Y north, Z up; Unreal (x*100, -y*100, z*100), yaw = -rot_z)

convention.centre: a point ON the receiving surface (ray-cast); the decal box is centred there
convention.normal: the surface's outward normal; the decal projects along -normal
convention.up / right: the texture's up (image top) and right on the surface; right = up x normal
convention.flip_u: mirror the texture across (variation); in Unreal: actor scale Y = -1
convention.ue.rotation_deg: UE rotator for local +X = -normal (projection), local +Z = up
convention.ue.decal_size_cm: UDecalComponent.DecalSize = HALF extents (depth, width, height) / 2 in cm
convention.verify: texture orientation in Unreal (which of the decal's local Y / Z is the image's U / V) is not measured here: check one wall decal (MossFoot_01: the moss must sit at the wall FOOT) in the first capture and flip up / right globally if needed

master.name: M_DKD_Decal_Master
master.note: one master, one instance per decal type; DBuffer decals render on Nanite and non-Nanite meshes (r.DBuffer 1, the UE 5.8 default); set bReceivesDecals false on the player character's meshes so a player walking through a wall-foot box is not stained

M_DKD_Decal_MossFoot.use: moss cushions + damp at a wall foot / the rubble footing (texture bottom row at the ground)

M_DKD_Decal_RainStreak.use: runoff streaks hanging from a drip line: under the wall caps and eaves (top row at the drip)

M_DKD_Decal_Grime.use: splash-back grime at post bases (bottom row at the post foot) and door thresholds (bottom row at the door, projected down)

M_DKD_Decal_Lichen.use: crustose lichen on roof tiles, wall caps and the stone lanterns

M_DKD_Decal_WaterStain.use: the ground stain under a downpipe shoe (bottom row at the shoe, up = the outflow)

M_DKD_Decal_WornPath.use: trodden gravel where feet leave the paving (hall stair, gate)
